modules.title: The course
modules.blurb: GitHub to Codespaces to Copilot to a shipped mini game.

lessons.title: Introduction to GitHub
lessons.objective: Repos, branches, commits, PRs — in an hour.
keys: Branch → commit → PR → review → merge: the loop
The README is the front door; write for strangers

lessons.title: Introduction to GitHub Codespaces
keys: Codespaces: VS Code in the browser, preconfigured by devcontainer
Custom images make the team environment reproducible

lessons.title: Introduction to GitHub Copilot
keys: Ghost text is the product: type intent, accept implementation
Comments as prompts — the highest-leverage habit
Reject freely; the second suggestion is often the one

lessons.title: Using GitHub Copilot with C#
keys: Craft prompts like tickets: context, language, framework, shape
Improve a Minimal API one endpoint-prompt at a time
Generated C# still gets code review — always

lessons.title: Creating a mini game with Copilot
keys: Game rules are precise specs — ideal prompt material
Build the loop, then the rules, then the polish
A shipped tiny game teaches more than an unshipped big one

lessons.title: Copilot for Azure — deploy to the cloud
keys: Ask Copilot for Azure to plan the deployment before clicking
Right-size the SKU: dev toys shouldn't run prod bills
Deploy → verify → tear down: the learning loop
